results.summary_before: This project implements a simple Tamagotchi virtual pet game in Verilog that communicates over a serial UART interface. The user connects rx and tx to a serial terminal, and the game starts automatically; the pet has stats for food, sleep, happiness, hygiene, and social, which must be maintained by pressing keys (E, S, P, B, T, W) to feed, sleep, play, clean, talk, or wake up. If the pet dies, the reset button restarts the game. The design requires a 27 MHz clock and a serial terminal; no silicon test results are provided.
